project.title: AQI Truth
project.short_description: IBM Db2 runs India's official CPCB AQI method on real Delhi monitor data and refuses to give an AQI when the data cannot support one, with an append-only evidence ledger, IBM Granite explanations checked by code, and a read-only natural-language question box.

members.name: Debi Prasad Samal
members.role: Solo: Db2 design, backend, AI, evaluation

features_used: SQL PL stored procedures and functions
Least-privilege authorization: read-only question-box ID on two views; SELECT+INSERT-only app ID
Row and column access control (row permission + column mask, AQAUDITOR role)
Materialized query table (REFRESH DEFERRED) with optimizer query rewrite
Hash-chained SHA-256 receipts verified from system-time history (SQL PL)

frameworks: LangChain (langchain-core LCEL chain + langchain-ollama) for the question box
